scope: One canonical fresh account; natural production combat, real keyboard/UI, loopback real auth/save handlers with isolated memory DB. Not production, Mongo durability, full chapter completion or win rate.
mutations: Only registration, real UI clicks and keyboard inputs; no damage hooks, HP/ATK edits, invulnerability, teleports, room jumps or resource grants.

metrics.bossDamageNote: No boss reached; boss damage not measured.
metrics.goldRateNote: Client-observed gold per wall-clock minute, including transitions/modal stall; persisted checkpoint may lag because of integration failure.
